description:
Bundle of patches for Bejeweled Classic (com.ea.gp.bej3, 4.0.0).
- Ad-free: removes advertisement placements.
- Crash-guard: injects null guards across the Java glue layer.
- Telemetry-disabled: suppresses analytics/telemetry endpoints and severs the tracking/Kinesis-Cognito chain, including consent/opt-in flags.
Developed with AI assistance; each patch statically verified at release time.

patches.name: Ad-free
patches.description: Removes ads. Rewarded ads still grant their reward without playing.

patches.name: Crash-guard
patches.description: Null-guards the GluAnalytics callback references (fixes latent NPEs).

patches.name: Cross-promo-redirect
patches.description: Redirects the GET STARS! cross-promo button to the GitHub repo (instead of promoting EA’s game).

patches.name: Network-cut
patches.description: Removes android.permission.INTERNET, disabling the network entirely (fail-closed). All telemetry and ads are structurally severed.

patches.name: Telemetry-disabled
patches.description: Stops Nimble/Synergy, Firebase, GLUAnalytics (incl. privacy flags), Facebook/Unity, popcap, and IronSource mediation telemetry.
